titleEn: Maximum Score After Applying Operations on a Tree
title: 在树上执行操作以后得到的最大分数
summary: 树的每个节点有一个正数值，可以把若干节点的值加入分数并清零；操作后每条从根到叶子的路径都必须仍有正值，求最大分数。
insight: 最大化取走的分数等价于最小化必须留下的总值。对一棵子树，可以留下当前根节点来同时覆盖所有叶路径，代价是 values[node]；也可以不留当前节点，转而让每棵孩子子树各自保持健康，代价是孩子最小代价之和，二者取小。叶子没有孩子，只能留下自身。
pitfalls: 健康条件作用于每一条根到叶路径
叶子节点不能被单独取空
答案和子树代价都可能超过 32 位整数
无向边需要从节点零定根后再做后序计算

solutions.title: 迭代后序树形 DP
solutions.idea: 先求必须保留的最小总值，再用所有节点总和减去它。
steps: 从根零迭代遍历并记录 parent 与 order
叶子的 keep 等于自身值
非叶节点令 childrenKeep 为所有孩子 keep 之和

code.java: class Solution { public long maximumScoreAfterOperations(int[][] edges,int[] values){int n=values.length;List<Integer>[] graph=new ArrayList[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)graph[i]=new ArrayList<>();for(int[] edge:edges){graph[edge[0]].add(edge[1]);graph[edge[1]].add(edge[0]);}int[] parent=new int[n],order=new int[n];Arrays.fill(parent,-1);parent[0]=0;int size=0;ArrayDeque<Integer> stack=new ArrayDeque<>();stack.push(0);while(!stack.isEmpty()){int node=stack.pop();order[size++]=node;for(int next:graph[node])if(parent[next]==-1){parent[next]=node;stack.push(next);}}long total=0;for(int value:values)total+=value;long[] keep=new long[n];for(int index=n-1;index>=0;index--){int node=order[index];long children=0;boolean leaf=true;for(int next:graph[node])if(parent[next]==node){leaf=false;children+=keep[next];}keep[node]=leaf?values[node]:Math.min((long)values[node],children);}return total-keep[0];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maximumScoreAfterOperations(edges:Array<IntArray>,values:IntArray):Long{val n=values.size;val graph=Array(n){mutableListOf<Int>()};for(edge in edges){graph[edge[0]].add(edge[1]);graph[edge[1]].add(edge[0])};val parent=IntArray(n){-1};val order=IntArray(n);parent[0]=0;var size=0;val stack=java.util.ArrayDeque<Int>();stack.push(0);while(stack.isNotEmpty()){val node=stack.pop();order[size++]=node;for(next in graph[node])if(parent[next]==-1){parent[next]=node;stack.push(next)}};var total=0L;for(value in values)total+=value;val keep=LongArray(n);for(index in n-1 downTo 0){val node=order[index];var children=0L;var leaf=true;for(next in graph[node])if(parent[next]==node){leaf=false;children+=keep[next]};keep[node]=if(leaf)values[node].toLong() else minOf(values[node].toLong(),children)};return total-keep[0]} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:long long maximumScoreAfterOperations(vector<vector<int>>& edges,vector<int>& values){int n=values.size();vector<vector<int>> graph(n);for(auto& edge:edges){graph[edge[0]].push_back(edge[1]);graph[edge[1]].push_back(edge[0]);}vector<int> parent(n,-1),order;parent[0]=0;stack<int> pending;pending.push(0);while(!pending.empty()){int node=pending.top();pending.pop();order.push_back(node);for(int next:graph[node])if(parent[next]==-1){parent[next]=node;pending.push(next);}}long long total=accumulate(values.begin(),values.end(),0LL);vector<long long> keep(n);for(int index=n-1;index>=0;--index){int node=order[index];long long children=0;bool leaf=true;for(int next:graph[node])if(parent[next]==node){leaf=false;children+=keep[next];}keep[node]=leaf?values[node]:min<long long>(values[node],children);}return total-keep[0];} };
